questions.question: You need to distinguish “kinetic enolate” from several related chapter concepts. Which description uniquely identifies it?

options.label: B
options.text: The less substituted enolate formed rapidly under low-temperature conditions (-78 °C) with a bulky base through irreversible deprotonation.

options.label: C
options.text: The selective alpha-bromination of a carboxylic acid using bromine and phosphorus tribromide (PBr3).

options.label: D
options.text: A synthetic method using ethyl acetoacetate to construct alpha-substituted methyl ketones via alkylation, hydrolysis, and decarboxylation.
